verdict.rationale: Obsidian Publish is a first-party hosting service for publishing notes as a wiki, knowledge base, or digital garden. The docs describe selecting the notes you want, pressing Publish, and having the site hosted at publish.obsidian.md, which covers selective in-app publishing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that internal links resolve as working links on the published site, independent or hands-on corroboration of the publishing workflow.
